newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar finishes stronger, just off high.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar finishes stronger, just off high.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar finished on Tuesday evening just off its highs, hovering at firmer levels after a spate of fund buying boosted the market.
August closed at $330.50 per tonne, a gain of $2.70 and just 20 cents off its high. It earlier touched a low of $327.50.
Positive technicals and good liquidity in the front-month spurred the funds into action, traders said.
Next resistance levels were pegged at $333.50 and then $341.00.
Most of the action was in August, accounting for 2,542 lots of the total turnover of 4,346 lots.
October also skated higher, adding $2.80 to $321.30.
A decent amount of Brazilian pricing was seen in London and New York, traders said.
